reference_sql:
SELECT a.segment, ROUND(SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit), 2) AS mrr_eur
FROM subscription_events e
JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY a.segment
alternatives:
WITH acct AS (
  -- one row per account with an event by 31 December 2025, in euros
  SELECT e.account_id, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY e.account_id
)
SELECT a.segment, ROUND(SUM(c.mrr_eur), 2) AS mrr_eur
FROM acct c
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = c.account_id
GROUP BY a.segment

other_way.sql:
WITH acct AS (
  -- one row per account with an event by 31 December 2025, in euros
  SELECT e.account_id, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY e.account_id
)
SELECT a.segment, ROUND(SUM(c.mrr_eur), 2) AS mrr_eur
FROM acct c
JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = c.account_id
GROUP BY a.segment
other_way.tradeoff: Working each account's balance out first lets you check it account by account before the segments are added up.

  FROM subscription_events e JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = e.account_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31') SELECT segment, ROUND(SUM(eur), 2) AS mrr_eur FROM ev WHERE event_date <= DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY segment
